description: Implementation of a configuration class for Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR transformation, including methods for request/response transformation and environment validation.

classes.name: VertexAIDeepSeekOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR transformation, handling request/response conversion and environment validation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OCR config with a VertexBase instance.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates environment and constructs headers with Bearer token for Vertex AI OCR.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR.

methods.name: transform_ocr_request
methods.description: Transforms OCR document into chat completion request format for Vertex AI.

methods.name: async_transform_ocr_request
methods.description: Asynchronous version of request transformation, calls sync method.

methods.name: transform_ocr_response
methods.description: Parses chat completion response and converts it into OCRResponse format.

methods.name: async_transform_ocr_response
methods.description: Asynchronous version of response transformation, calls sync method.
